name: Glitch-Free Reactive Dataflow
description: Repair a spreadsheet-style reactive engine so propagation is glitch-free: dependents are marked dirty transitively, dirty cells recompute exactly once per wave in topological rank order, cycles are rejected, and batched source writes collapse into a single wave with no observable intermediate states.
planted_defect: topo.topo_order returns arbitrary set order without dependency ranking
graph.dirty_from marks dependents without setting dirty flag
batch.flush propagates once per write instead of one wave
